safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions occasional shoulder pain with movement but does not state tingling/numbness in the shoulder as in the Gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether symptoms extend into the shoulder can help localize pathology (cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus vs distal neuropathy), but in the transcript the shoulder symptom described is intermittent pain with movement rather than clear sensory loss. This omission is unlikely to change urgent neurology referral/escalation advice given the more significant arm numbness/weakness and transient visual loss.

Because this vomiting (if present) occurred over a month ago and current care focus is neurologic symptoms, the impact is more likely limited to completeness and downstream diagnostic context.
